title: AI Through the Human Lens: Investigating Cognitive Theories in Machine Psychology

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to 230 pairs of questions that vary only in positive versus negative framing (gain vs. loss wording) to assess whether the models exhibit contradiction or entailment, revealing optimism or negativity biases.

Using an expanded Moral Foundations Theory questionnaire containing 360 situationally grounded dilemmas to test six moral dimensions (e.g., Care/Harm, Liberty/Oppression) and comparing the models' 0-5 ratings against a human baseline.
